clause: DESIGN R3.3 §10.2 Export recipe, capability and loss contract
witness: every export-ir/1 kind, edge endpoints, artifact-global and page metadata, each loss class through the loss action mapping, adapter-declared metadata losses
derivation: Recipes in order: pages, nodes (+ loss appearance after each emit), edges (endpoints bound through sourceOccurrence/targetOccurrence), labels, global metadata (self = Definitions, no parent), page metadata (parent = page id), losses (eight loss actions on s-task-a with aliases of self). Planned keys: page e_0, nodes s-task-a e_1 / s-task-b e_2 (reused by the edge endpoints), edge e-flow e_3, label e-flow e_4. Loss action entries: code export-loss/<class>, messageKey export.loss.<class>, loss/warn/export/mapped, lossClass = class, ruleId = recipe id, source = Task_A tree coordinate; the node losses point at the node just emitted (/ir/1, /ir/2), the export-losses recipe emits nothing so its results are unavailable. The drawio/1 adapter serializes no metadata record, so it declares one export-loss/metadata entry per emitted metadata record (DESIGN §10.2 'cannot arbitrarily omit a common supported field without advertising a capability loss'): ruleId adapter, result = the metadata record /ir/5 or /ir/6 (targetId null), source = the emitting self (Definitions_x at the root pointer, unavailable for the PageHandle, pageId P1 for the page metadata). Entries sort by ruleId (adapter < export-losses < export-nodes), then source. R coverage lists every ID-bearing element in native pre-order (harmonization G3); read-only Result/1 with the B4 report header (source = target = envelope identity, input = output revision); PreparedArtifact.report is the same Report/2 record.
